column1: # Async lane registry — every dispatched lane has a convention name
#   <harness>-<model>-<host>-<task>, lowercase, no spaces. The harness segment is not
#   optional: without it a mcode lane and a pi lane running the same model are
# model: the model that ran. A canonical alias, or the exact catalog identifier,
#   optionally with an effort marker such as " (fast)".
# surface: the host the lane ran on. A legacy "/pane" suffix is allowed
#   ("brandon/async-1"). Rows written before 2026-10-19 in the legacy layout recorded
#   the lane's effort marker here instead of a host; such a row records no host, so
#   its lane_key host segment is not cross-checked.
# run_id: a UUID unique to ONE lane. A workflow run id shared by sibling lanes is not
#   a lane id; give each row its own.
# Owner: firstmate. Write a row at dispatch, update `state` at every phase change, never delete a row
# while a run exists. Deleting a row whose run is gone is a reap, not a cleanup.
